note: Expected findings are the code, path, message and suggestion `orb validate` (the Rust validator) reports for the same program. Cases copy tests/expectations_validation.rs (a_provider_without_the_identity_tag_is_a_kind_mismatch, an_entity_expectation_checks_the_storage_mode_shared_and_local, control_an_entity_expectation_that_states_no_storage_constrains_none, an_entity_expectation_checks_key_and_unique_marks, an_entity_expectation_compares_access_policies_structurally, a_page_expectation_checks_the_traits_the_provider_page_mounts) and tests/expects_page_slice.rs (the boot and route page-trait tests); the rest pin the other policy ops, browser, the persistence default and the named-identity controls. The shape-field arms (a missing field, requiredness, vocabulary, type compatibility) and the event-payload and config-knob arms of the same Rust functions are other rules.

findings.message: `ProductOrbital` expects `Customer` to be the [identity] entity, but `CustomerOrbital` provides `Customer` without the [identity] tag — `@user` will never resolve to it.
findings.suggestion: Tag `Customer` [identity] in `CustomerOrbital`, or change the expectation to `expects entity Customer`.

findings.message: `ConsumerOrbital` expects `OrderRecord` to be runtime, but it is persistent.
findings.suggestion: Change `OrderRecord`'s storage mode, or the expectation's.

findings.message: `ConsumerOrbital` expects `OrderRecord` to be `shared`, but it is not.
findings.suggestion: Tag `OrderRecord` `[shared]`, or drop the tag from the expectation.

findings.message: `ConsumerOrbital` expects `OrderRecord` to be `browser`, but it is not.
findings.suggestion: Tag `OrderRecord` `[browser]`, or drop the tag from the expectation.

findings.message: `ConsumerOrbital` expects `OrderRecord.email` to be marked `@unique`; `OrderRecord` declares it without.
findings.suggestion: Mark `email` `@unique` in `OrderRecord`, or drop the mark from the expectation.

findings.message: `ConsumerOrbital` expects `OrderRecord.id` to be marked `@key`; `OrderRecord` declares it without.
findings.suggestion: Mark `id` `@key` in `OrderRecord`, or drop the mark from the expectation.

findings.message: `ConsumerOrbital` expects `OrderRecord` to carry the `@read` policy it states, but its `@read` is a different expression.
findings.suggestion: Make `OrderRecord`'s `@read` the same expression, or change the expectation.

findings.message: `ConsumerOrbital` expects `OrderRecord` to carry the `@read` policy it states, but its `@read` is absent.
findings.suggestion: Make `OrderRecord`'s `@read` the same expression, or change the expectation.

findings.message: `ConsumerOrbital` expects `OrderRecord` to carry the `@delete` policy it states, but its `@delete` is absent.
findings.suggestion: Make `OrderRecord`'s `@delete` the same expression, or change the expectation.

findings.message: `ConsumerOrbital` expects `OrderRecord` to declare `@update none` (its omission, with a reason), but it does not.
findings.suggestion: Declare `@update none "<reason>"` on `OrderRecord`, or drop it from the expectation.

findings.message: `ConsumerOrbital` expects page `/orders` to mount Receipt, but the page mounts: OrderFlow.
findings.suggestion: Mount Receipt on the page, or drop it from the expectation.

findings.message: `Worker` expects a `boot` page to mount Tick, but the page mounts: Seed.
findings.suggestion: Mount Tick on the page, or drop it from the expectation.

findings.message: `Worker` expects page `/home` to mount Tick, but the page mounts: Seed.
findings.suggestion: Mount Tick on the page, or drop it from the expectation.
